profile.headline: Senior Business Systems Analyst | Technical Business Analyst | .NET | SQL Server | Requirements Analysis | SDLC | Application & Data Analysis
profile.summary:
Technical Business Systems Analyst and experienced .NET/SQL software professional with a strong background in application development, database analysis, systems troubleshooting, requirements analysis and SDLC processes.

I bring a combination of hands-on technical development experience and the ability to understand business needs, analyze existing systems, identify process and system requirements, and work with technical and business stakeholders to deliver effective solutions.

I am currently focused on Business Systems Analyst, Technical Business Analyst opportunities where my software development background can provide additional technical value.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•     Collaborated with other developers and business users to create the requirements.
•     Created technical documentation and system specifications.
•     Designed database tables and objects.
•     Wrote SQL queries and procedures to retrieve and validate data.
•     Developed web application on a SQL Server database using C#.net for frontend.
•     Used AI tools to optimize some database and code issues.
positions.insights: C#.NET, IT Business Analysis and +8 skills

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Analyzed business requirements and translated them into technical solutions.
•      Worked with stakeholders to understand requirements and business processes.
•      Analyzed existing applications and databases to identify system issues and improvement opportunities.
•      Investigated production issues and performed root-cause analysis.
•	Created technical documentation and system specifications.
•      Collaborated with developers, QA, business users and project stakeholders throughout the SDLC.
•      Wrote SQL queries to validate, reconcile and analyze application data.
•	Used AI tools for debugging and testing, improving delivery speed and quality.

Key Projects:
     o	Certification System: Managed training certifications for 2200+ weekly users, including SOPs, exams, and acknowledgment tracking.
     o	Content Management System: Legal contract tracking with custom notifications and automated updates.
     o	Treasury Application: Workflow-based approval system for financial tracking and reporting.
     o	Herald Subscription Web App: PR department news delivery platform with dynamic content.
     o	Inventory Tracking Application: Asset verification and transfer approval for Tax and IT departments.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Designed, developed, and tested enhancements for pipeline management software using MVC, C#.NET, Entity Framework, PL/SQL, and T-SQL.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•       Analyzed business requirements and translated them into working applications and/or enhancements.
•       Worked with stakeholders to understand applicatiton requirements and business processes.
•	Developed custom manufacturing software solutions for switch-gear engineering.
•	Managed full SDLC including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, documentation, and production deployment.
•	Built Microsoft Windows applications, websites, and WCF services using C#.NET and Oracle databases.
